title: Amelioration of endothelial integrity by 3,5,4'-trihydroxy-trans-stilbene against high-fat-diet-induced obesity and -associated vasculopathy and myocardial infarction in rats, targeting TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/iNOS signaling cascade.
authors: Singh, Jitender; Bisht, Priyanka; Srivastav, Srishti; Kumar, Yash; Sharma, Vikash; Kumar, Ashish; Akhtar, Md Sayeed; Khan, Mohd Faiyaz; Aldosari, Saad A; Yadav, Snehlata; Yadav, Nirmala K; Mukherjee, Monalisa; Sharma, Arun K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇通过TLR4/MyD88/NF-kB/iNOS信号通路改善肥胖相关血管和心肌损伤，仅含蛋白-配体分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Exacerbated expression of TLR4 protein (foremost pattern recognition receptor) during obesity could trigger NF-kappaB/iNOS signaling through linker protein (MyD88), predisposed to an indispensable inflammatory response. The induction of this detrimental cascade leads to myocardial and vascular abnormalities. Molecular docking was studied for protein-ligand interaction between these potential targets and resveratrol. The pre-treatment of resveratrol (20 mg/kg/p.o/per day for ten weeks) was given to investigate the therapeutic effect against HFD-induced obesity and associated vascular endothelial dysfunction (VED) and myocardial infarction (MI) in Wistar rats. In addition to accessing the levels of serum biomarkers for VED and MI, oxidative stress, inflammatory cytokines, and histopathology of these tissues were investigated. Lipopolysaccharide (for receptor activation) and protein expression analysis were introduced to explore the mechanistic involvement of TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/iNOS signaling. Assessment of in-silico analysis showed significant interaction between protein and ligand. The involvement of this proposed signaling (TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/iNOS) was further endorsed by the impact of lipopolysaccharide and protein expression analysis in obese and treated rats. Moreover, resveratrol pre-treated rats showed significantly lowered cardio and vascular damage measured by the distinct down expression of the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/iNOS pathway by resveratrol treatment endorses its ameliorative effect against VED and MI.
abstract_zh: 肥胖期间TLR4蛋白（最主要的模式识别受体）表达加剧，可能通过接头蛋白（MyD88）触发NF-kappaB/iNOS信号通路，从而易导致不可或缺的炎症反应。这一有害级联反应的诱导引发心肌和血管异常。研究了这些潜在靶点与白藜芦醇之间的蛋白质-配体相互作用的分子对接。给予白藜芦醇预处理（20 mg/kg/口服/每天，持续十周），以研究其对Wistar大鼠高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的肥胖及相关血管内皮功能障碍（VED）和心肌梗死（MI）的治疗效果。除了检测VED和MI的血清生物标志物水平外，还研究了氧化应激、炎症细胞因子以及这些组织的组织病理学。引入脂多糖（用于受体激活）和蛋白表达分析，以探讨TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/iNOS信号通路的机制参与。计算机模拟分析评估显示蛋白质与配体之间存在显著相互作用。所提出的信号通路（TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/iNOS）的参与进一步得到脂多糖影响及肥胖和 treated 大鼠蛋白表达分析的支持。此外，白藜芦醇预处理的大鼠显示出显著降低的心脏和血管损伤，通过白藜芦醇处理对TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB/iNOS通路的明显下调表达，证实了其对VED和MI的改善作用。
